property_summary: After a user withdraws all their funds, any subsequent deposit and withdrawal by the same user must not yield more total withdrawn than total deposited; the bug leaves a residual credit of 1 wei that can be withdrawn later, causing the cumulative withdrawn amount to exceed the cumulative deposited amount.
change_summary: Replace 'credit[msg.sender] = 0;' with 'credit[msg.sender] = 1;' so that credit is not fully cleared, allowing a residual credit of 1 wei to persist and be withdrawable later.
